releaseNotes:
• Android User Policy & Access Center (v2.0.0): Added prominent data-use disclosures, Health Connect ACTION_SHOW_PERMISSIONS_RATIONALE & VIEW_PERMISSION_USAGE intent handling, and explicit user consent management.
• Android 13+ Restricted Settings Guide: Built-in step-by-step guide & direct App Info / Usage Access shortcuts per Google Android Help (12623953).
• Google Play & Scoped Storage Compliance: Removed unused/restricted permissions (READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, BODY_SENSORS, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES) and migrated Documents/PulseForge AI exports to Scoped Storage MediaStore.Files.
